Operator:
Good day, and welcome to the AetherCloud Technologies Q3 FY2024 Earnings Conference Call. All participants are in listen-only mode. After the presentation, we will conduct a question-and-answer session. If you would like to ask a question at that time, please press star then one on your touchtone phone. If using a speakerphone, please pick up the handset before pressing the keys. As a reminder, this conference is being recorded.

I would now like to turn the call over to Alex Rivera, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead.

Alex Rivera:
Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining us. Today, we will be discussing AetherCloud Technologies's results for the Q3 FY2024. With me on the call are Raj Patel, Chief Executive Officer; Sarah Kline, Chief Financial Officer; Dr. Elena Vasquez, Chief Technology Officer; and Mike Chen, Chief Product Officer.

Before we begin, I would like to remind you that today's call contains forward-looking statements. These statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Please refer to our SEC filings for a complete discussion of these risks.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Raj Patel.

Raj Patel:
Thank you, Alex, and good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for joining us today. AetherCloud Technologies had an exceptional Q3, exceeding expectations across all key metrics. This success is a testament to our innovative technology, dedicated team, and strong customer relationships.

During the quarter, we focused on five key areas:
1. Expanding our market share in key verticals.
2. Investing in cutting-edge research and development.
3. Enhancing our cloud security posture.
4. Driving operational efficiencies.
5. Strengthening our ecosystem partnerships.

Let me highlight some of our key achievements from the quarter and outline our strategic priorities as we continue to lead in the cloud computing landscape. In Q3 FY2024, AetherCloud delivered outstanding performance that reinforces our dominance in hyperscale infrastructure, AI-driven workloads, and multi-cloud orchestration.

On the financial front, we achieved record quarterly revenue of $28.7 billion, up 31% year-over-year and 8% quarter-over-quarter, beating our guidance by a significant margin. This growth was powered by a 35% surge in Infrastructure Cloud Services to around $18.2 billion, driven by booming demand for our AetherAI GPU clusters, which achieved utilization rates over 92%, on par with the best in class for high-performance computing and inference. Platform and SaaS revenues climbed 28% to $6.4 billion, with our AetherOrchestrator platform—a Kubernetes-native multi-cloud manager—accounting for more than 40% of that increase through major enterprise adoptions.

Our remaining performance obligations reached a peak of $195 billion, up 44% year-over-year, with current RPO at $72 billion, providing excellent visibility into future billings. Non-GAAP operating margins expanded to 32%, up 300 basis points, thanks to optimized data center total cost of ownership—now at competitive levels for GPU-hour pricing—and improved capex efficiency. Customer additions totaled 1,200 net new, pushing our base to over 68,000, including nearly 200 Fortune 500 names. Large customers spending more than $1 million annually grew 45% year-over-year, comprising 62% of revenue. Standout wins included a massive multi-year contract with an autonomous vehicle leader for edge AI at thousands of sites and expansions with global banks migrating VMware workloads to our hypervisor tech.

Regionally, North America powered 52% of revenue with 29% growth, fueled by U.S. hyperscalers and federal deals. EMEA accelerated 36% to 27% of total, thanks to sovereign cloud zones in key markets where we've grabbed substantial public sector share. APAC shone brightest at 38% growth to 21%, led by ramps in Japan and India, while emerging markets like LatAm doubled contributions.

Technically, we rolled out AetherEdge 2.0, handling 2.5 exabytes of real-time IoT data daily at sub-10ms latency for telco giants. Sustainability advanced with 65% renewable energy matching across 120 global zones and PUE down to 1.15 via liquid cooling. Third-party analysts like Canalys confirm our global cloud infrastructure share at 14%, closing in on leaders, especially in AI/ML at 22%.

Turning to priorities, we're honing in on AI ubiquity, global sovereignty, and sustainable hyperscale. For AI, $14 billion in FY2024 capex includes heavy allocation to next-gen infrastructure like 500,000 NVIDIA H200 GPUs and our AetherTensor custom chips for superior efficiency. We'll launch AetherGenAI Studio for cost-effective LLM fine-tuning and deepen ties with AI pioneers. On sovereignty, 20 new zones target regulations like EU Data Act, with AetherFederate enabling seamless multi-cloud bursting. Sustainability pushes include advanced energy sources and photonic tech for lower latency.

These efforts validate our flywheel of innovation, enterprise wins, and scaling, setting us up for 30%+ growth amid a 25% market CAGR.

Now I'll turn the call over to Sarah Kline to discuss our financial results in more detail.

Sarah Kline:
Thank you, Raj. As Raj mentioned, we had a stellar financial performance in the Q3. Revenue grew by 31% year-over-year to $28.7 billion, significantly outpacing industry averages. Our gross margin was 68.2%, reflecting our pricing power and efficient cost management. Our operating margin was 32%.

Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining us on AetherCloud's Q3 FY2024 earnings call. I'm thrilled to kick off our financial highlights with what was another blockbuster quarter, underscoring the durability and acceleration of our cloud leadership amid a rapidly evolving industry. We delivered results that significantly exceeded our guidance and consensus expectations, driven by insatiable demand for our AI-optimized infrastructure, sovereign cloud offerings, and next-gen data analytics platforms.

Total revenue hit $28.7 billion, up 31% year-over-year and 8% quarter-over-quarter, or 33% on a constant currency basis. This is our 12th straight quarter of 30%+ growth, surpassing broader IaaS/PaaS market expansion around 25% globally per Synergy Research. Strength came from volume and pricing in premium areas like GPU-intensive AI, where revenue per hyperscale instance has more than doubled year-over-year.

By segment: Infrastructure Cloud Services at $18.2 billion, 63% of total, up 35% on 45% ramps in NVIDIA H100/A100 GPUs for generative AI scaling, with 92% utilization via AutoScaler. Platform and Developer Services contributed $6.4 billion, up 28%, led by 40% growth in serverless invocations with zero-cold-start tech. Data and AI Services exploded to $4.1 billion, up 42%, adding 1,200 net new customers; AI/ML now 55% of DAS revenue, boosted by AetherSpark lakehouse and AetherLLM integrations.

Customer metrics shine: $14.5 billion TCV signed, $3.2 billion net new ACV—record high. NRR at 128%, with 85% of top 1,000 customers on AI-native apps. 142 deals over $10 million TCV, up 25%, including EU sovereign wins.

Regions: Americas $14.9 billion, up 29%; EMEA $7.8 billion, up 36% on sovereign zones; APAC $6.0 billion, up 38% with high-capacity Mumbai/Tokyo.

Profitability: GAAP gross margin 68.2%, up 210 bps; non-GAAP 71.5% from lower power costs and PUE 1.15. Non-GAAP op income $9.1 billion, 32% margin despite $1.2 billion AI R&D. OpEx 39% of revenue with controlled hiring.

Balance sheet strong: $85 billion cash; op cash flow $11.4 billion; FCF $8.2 billion post $3.2 billion capex. RPO $195 billion, up 44%.

Strategically, AI positions us centrally; capex to $14 billion FY2024 for 20 AI zones. NVIDIA partnerships unlock pipeline; 65% renewables ahead of peers. Raised FY2024 revenue to $113.5-114.5 billion, 31-32% growth; op margin 31-32%; Q4 $30.0-30.4 billion.

Now, turning to our capital expenditure outlook and investment plans, which are central to capturing explosive cloud demand from generative AI, migrations, and edge. In Q3, we deployed $3.2 billion in CapEx, up from prior periods, with first-nine-months totaling around $10 billion, on track with guidance. Spend emphasized data center expansion—65%—to back 35% IaaS growth and 42% AI/ML surge.

We're raising full-year FY2024 CapEx to $26-29 billion, 22-32% over last year, or 14-16% of revenue, matching hyperscaler peers amid GPU constraints. Q4 at $7.0-7.5 billion, front-loaded for builds.

By category: Data centers/facilities 55-60% ($14.3-17.4 billion)—new 100MW+ regions in Northern Virginia, São Paulo, Jakarta with liquid-cooled H100/Blackwell clusters; modular designs cut deploy time. Servers/compute 20-25% ($5.2-7.3 billion)—150,000 Nexara Graviton4 CPUs, 50,000 NVIDIA GPUs, custom AI chips for 40% inference savings. Networking/edge 10-12% ($2.6-3.5 billion)—400Gbps optics, subsea cables, 500 edge sites. Other 5-8%—$800 million renewables for 70% match, quantum-safe crypto.

Allocation: U.S. 58%, EMEA 22% for sovereign, APAC 15%, LatAm 5%. 70% tied to contracts for quick utilization; diversified supply, hedged power. Into FY2025-26, stabilizes at 12-14% as software efficiencies reduce overprovisioning 25%, shifting to hybrid integrations.

This positions 25-30% capacity growth, outpacing forecasts.

Before handing over, a note on currency fluctuations' impact on revenue. As a global player with 48% international revenue, FX is key. In Q3, headwinds trimmed $450 million, or 1.6 points off growth; constant currency was 33%. Primarily EMEA (euro down 7.2% QoQ, $180 million drag despite 45% AI growth) and APAC (yen down 9.5%, $150 million; others $120 million), with LatAm adding pressure. North America resilient at 52%.

Cumulative headwinds $1.2 billion past three quarters. Outlook: Q4 $300-350 million headwind, but constant currency 30%+ growth.

Mitigations: 70% hedging coverage, 85% local billing, sovereign builds like São Paulo II, edge for low-latency, AI commitments less FX-sensitive.

Now, I'll hand it over to Dr. Elena Vasquez for a technical update.

Dr. Elena Vasquez:
Thank you, Sarah. From a technology perspective, we made significant strides in several key areas this quarter. We are proud to announce the general availability of our new AetherShield platform, which offers unparalleled performance and scalability in threat prevention.

Thank you, and good afternoon, everyone. As CTO, I'm taking a moment to detail our data breach prevention and incident response measures—one of our strongest moats in an industry where security underpins trust and growth. With AWS at 32% share, Azure 23%, Google 12% per Synergy Q3 2024, breaches like MOVEit or Okta have cost peers dearly. At AetherCloud, our $100+ billion RPO reflects zero reportable breaches in 24 months and 99.999% durability SLAs.

Prevention via defense-in-depth, NIST-aligned zero-trust: $700 million FY2024 security CapEx, up 28% YoY. AetherShield AI/ML blocks 99.7% anomalous calls on 15PB telemetry—2.8 billion threats neutralized Q3, 40% better than signatures. Confidential computing on 85% DCs with SGX/SEV-SNP for memory encryption, driving 22% regulated customer growth ($1.2 billion bookings). Supply chain: 100% audits, SLSA Level 3, vuln exposure down 65% to 0.42%.

Regionally: EMEA sovereign zero notifications, 97.5% retention; APAC homomorphic encryption for 15% sovereign growth.

Detection: SOC with 450 analysts, 1,200 ML models; MTTD 4.2 minutes vs. industry 197 days. Sentinel XDR ingests 500TB/day, flagged 1.45 million zero-days. CSPM auto-fixes 78% misconfigs.

Response: MTTR 23 minutes vs. 92 industry. Tiered teams, Chaos drills contain in 12 minutes; SOAR auto-isolates 97%; partnerships with CrowdStrike/Mandiant cut costs 55%. Zero warranty claims on $10M coverage; security NPS 78, upsells $450 million Q3, churn <1.2%.

Outlook: PQC migration 60% by FY25; Secure Fabric for multi-cloud; regional certs like FedRAMP High for $2B pipelines. Security fuels 25%+ CAGR.

I'll now pass it to Mike Chen for a product roadmap update.

Mike Chen:
Thank you, Elena. This quarter, we launched AetherEdge 2.0, a game-changing solution for edge computing and latency-sensitive markets like 5G and IoT. Early customer feedback has been overwhelmingly positive. We are seeing strong demand and a rapid increase in adoption across telcos and enterprises, processing exabytes daily with sub-10ms performance. Our roadmap emphasizes AI-native products, sovereign integrations, and sustainable innovations, building on sovereign zones and multi-cloud tools to drive further expansion in high-growth verticals.

Now, back to Raj Patel.

Raj Patel:
Thank you, Mike. We are incredibly excited about the future. We believe our investments in innovation, our commitment to customer success, and our talented team will continue to drive strong growth and value creation.

With that, let's open the call for questions.

Operator:
Ladies and gentlemen, if you would like to ask a question, please press star then one. Our first question comes from Ben Thompson with Morgan Stanley. Please go ahead.

Ben Thompson:
Thanks for taking my question, and congrats on the outstanding quarter. Raj, can you expand on the sustainability of AI demand, particularly as we think about enterprise adoption beyond hyperscalers?

Raj Patel:
Thanks, Ben. Absolutely, AI demand remains robust and broadening. We've seen enterprises ramping generative AI models on our GPU clusters, with 55% of DAS revenue now AI/ML, up from 40%. Wins like the EU Gaia Alliance and Fortune 500 migrations show stickiness—NRR at 128%. Our AetherGenAI Studio will lower barriers, targeting 50% training cost cuts. Partnerships with NVIDIA and others position us for the $200 billion enterprise AI spend Gartner forecasts by 2027. We're confident in 30%+ growth trajectory.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Lisa Chen with JPMorgan. Please go ahead.

Lisa Chen:
Great results, team. Sarah, with CapEx ramping to $26-29 billion, how should we think about returns and margin trajectory into FY2025?

Sarah Kline:
Thanks, Lisa. Our CapEx is disciplined, 70% committed to multi-year contracts ensuring 85-90% utilization within a year. We've optimized PUE to 1.15 and power costs 15% via renewables, driving gross margins to 71.5% non-GAAP. Op margins hit 32% despite R&D; we expect stabilization at 12-14% of revenue long-term as efficiencies like auto-scaling kick in. FY2025 FCF projected strong at $30+ billion, funding further innovation while sustaining rule-of-85+.

Operator:
Our next question comes from David Lee with Barclays. Please go ahead.

David Lee:
Congrats again. Elena, given recent industry breaches, can you update us on your security posture and any new measures?

Dr. Elena Vasquez:
Thanks, David. Security is foundational. Our zero-trust model neutralized 2.8 billion threats Q3 via AI-powered Shield. MTTD 4.2 minutes, MTTR 23—far ahead of benchmarks. Confidential computing covers 85% DCs, supply chain hardened to 0.42% vuln rate. Quarterly Chaos drills and SOAR automation ensure rapid containment. Zero breaches, zero claims on $10M warranties. We're advancing PQC crypto and multi-cloud federation, directly contributing to 14% workload expansions.

Raj Patel:
Thank you for your insightful questions and your continued interest in AetherCloud Technologies. We remain focused on executing our strategy and delivering long-term value for our shareholders.

Alex Rivera:
Thank you for joining us today. This concludes the call.

Operator:
This concludes today's conference call. Thank you for your participation. You may now disconnect.
